items.question: Trong câu "A computer network is a collection of multiple devices (computers, phones, printers, etc.) connected together to share data and resources.", từ "share" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A computer network is a collection of multiple devices (computers, phones, printers, etc.) connected together to share data and resources.", what does "share" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: share /ʃeər/ (động từ): dùng chung, chia sẻ. "Share data and resources" = dùng chung dữ liệu và tài nguyên; danh từ "share" còn là cổ phần.
items.explanationEn: share /ʃeər/ (verb): to use or have together. "Share data and resources" means using them together; the noun "share" can also mean a stock.

items.question: Trong câu "A network enables you to: send email, browse the web, share files, hold online meetings, print over the network, and more.", từ "enable" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A network enables you to: send email, browse the web, share files, hold online meetings, print over the network, and more.", what does "enable" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enable /ɪˈneɪ.bəl/ (động từ): cho phép, giúp có thể. Cấu trúc "enable someone to do something"; trong phần mềm "enable" còn là bật tính năng (trái nghĩa: disable).
items.explanationEn: enable /ɪˈneɪ.bəl/ (verb): to make someone able to. Pattern: "enable someone to do something"; in software it also means to switch on (opposite: disable).

items.question: Trong câu "A network enables you to: send email, browse the web, share files, hold online meetings, print over the network, and more.", từ "browse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A network enables you to: send email, browse the web, share files, hold online meetings, print over the network, and more.", what does "browse" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to copy files from the web
items.explanation: browse /braʊz/ (động từ): duyệt (web). "Browse the web" = lướt web; danh từ: browser (trình duyệt).
items.explanationEn: browse /braʊz/ (verb): to look through web pages. "Browse the web" means looking at pages; noun: browser.

items.question: Trong câu "A network enables you to: send email, browse the web, share files, hold online meetings, print over the network, and more.", từ "hold" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A network enables you to: send email, browse the web, share files, hold online meetings, print over the network, and more.", what does "hold" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to organise a meeting or event
to wait on a phone call
items.explanation: hold /həʊld/ (động từ): tổ chức (cuộc họp). "Hold a meeting/an event" = tổ chức cuộc họp/sự kiện; "hold" còn nghĩa là cầm hoặc chứa.
items.explanationEn: hold /həʊld/ (verb): to organise a meeting or event. "Hold a meeting/an event" means organising it; "hold" can also mean grip or contain.

items.question: Trong câu "Connects devices within a small area: an office, a school, a home.", từ "within" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Connects devices within a small area: an office, a school, a home.", what does "within" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: within /wɪˈðɪn/ (giới từ): trong phạm vi. "Within a small area" = trong một khu vực nhỏ; "within 24 hours" = trong vòng 24 giờ.
items.explanationEn: within /wɪˈðɪn/ (preposition): inside the limits of. "Within a small area" means inside it; "within 24 hours" means before 24 hours pass.

items.question: Trong câu "Connects devices within a small area: an office, a school, a home.", từ "area" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Connects devices within a small area: an office, a school, a home.", what does "area" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: area /ˈeə.ri.ə/ (danh từ): khu vực. "Local Area Network" = mạng cục bộ trong một khu vực; "area" còn là diện tích hoặc lĩnh vực.
items.explanationEn: area /ˈeə.ri.ə/ (noun): a part of a place. "Local Area Network" covers one place; "area" can also mean size of a surface or a field of study.

items.question: Trong câu "Connects LANs across large geographic distances: cities, countries, the whole world.", từ "across" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Connects LANs across large geographic distances: cities, countries, the whole world.", what does "across" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: across /əˈkrɒs/ (giới từ): trải khắp, xuyên qua. "Across countries/regions" = trải qua nhiều quốc gia/vùng; gặp nhiều trong "across multiple servers".
items.explanationEn: across /əˈkrɒs/ (preposition): over the whole of. "Across countries/regions" means spanning them; common in "across multiple servers".

items.question: Trong câu "Connects LANs across large geographic distances: cities, countries, the whole world.", từ "geographic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Connects LANs across large geographic distances: cities, countries, the whole world.", what does "geographic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: geographic /ˌdʒiː.əˈɡræf.ɪk/ (tính từ): (thuộc) địa lý. "Geographic distances/regions" = khoảng cách/vùng địa lý; danh từ: geography.
items.explanationEn: geographic /ˌdʒiː.əˈɡræf.ɪk/ (adjective): relating to places on Earth. "Geographic distances/regions" are about places; noun: geography.

items.question: Trong câu "Connects LANs across large geographic distances: cities, countries, the whole world.", từ "distance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Connects LANs across large geographic distances: cities, countries, the whole world.", what does "distance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: distance /ˈdɪs.təns/ (danh từ): khoảng cách. "Large distances" = khoảng cách lớn; tính từ: distant; "at a distance" = ở xa.
items.explanationEn: distance /ˈdɪs.təns/ (noun): the space between two places. "Large distances" are long spaces between places; adjective: distant.

items.question: Trong câu "Covers the scope of a single city.", từ "cover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Covers the scope of a single city.", what does "cover" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to hide or put something over
items.explanation: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ (động từ): bao phủ, trải rộng. "Cover a city" = phủ sóng/trải rộng một thành phố; "coverage" = vùng phủ sóng.
items.explanationEn: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ (verb): to extend over an area. "Cover a city" means spanning it; noun: coverage.

items.question: Trong câu "Covers the scope of a single city.", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Covers the scope of a single city.", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the range an area or topic spans
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi. "The scope of a city/project" = phạm vi thành phố/dự án; hay gặp "out of scope" (ngoài phạm vi).
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (noun): the range an area or topic spans. "The scope of a city/project" is its range; common in "out of scope".

items.question: Trong câu "Covers the scope of a single city.", từ "single" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Covers the scope of a single city.", what does "single" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: single /ˈsɪŋ.ɡəl/ (tính từ): duy nhất, một. "A single city" = chỉ một thành phố; "single point of failure" = điểm lỗi duy nhất.
items.explanationEn: single /ˈsɪŋ.ɡəl/ (adjective): only one. "A single city" means just one; "single point of failure" is a common IT phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Example: the internal network of a university with multiple campuses.", từ "internal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Example: the internal network of a university with multiple campuses.", what does "internal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: internal /ɪnˈtɜː.nəl/ (tính từ): nội bộ. "Internal network" = mạng nội bộ; trái nghĩa: external.
items.explanationEn: internal /ɪnˈtɜː.nəl/ (adjective): used only inside an organisation. "Internal network" is used inside only; opposite: external.

items.question: Trong câu "Example: the internal network of a university with multiple campuses.", từ "campus" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Example: the internal network of a university with multiple campuses.", what does "campus" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: campus /ˈkæm.pəs/ (danh từ): cơ sở, khuôn viên (trường). "Multiple campuses" = nhiều cơ sở; "on campus" = trong khuôn viên trường/công ty.
items.explanationEn: campus /ˈkæm.pəs/ (noun): the grounds of a university. "Multiple campuses" means several sites; "on campus" means on the grounds.

items.question: Trong câu "It routes data packets to their correct destination.", từ "route" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It routes data packets to their correct destination.", what does "route" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to send along a chosen path
items.explanation: route /ruːt/ (động từ): định tuyến, dẫn đường. "Route packets to a destination" = định tuyến gói tin đến đích; danh từ: route (tuyến đường), router.
items.explanationEn: route /ruːt/ (verb): to send along a chosen path. "Route packets to a destination" means sending them along a path; nouns: route, router.

items.question: Trong câu "It routes data packets to their correct destination.", từ "correct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It routes data packets to their correct destination.", what does "correct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: correct /kəˈrekt/ (tính từ): đúng. "The correct destination" = đích đến đúng; động từ "correct" = sửa lỗi.
items.explanationEn: correct /kəˈrekt/ (adjective): right, without mistakes. "The correct destination" is the right one; the verb "correct" means to fix.

items.question: Trong câu "It routes data packets to their correct destination.", từ "destination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It routes data packets to their correct destination.", what does "destination" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the place something is sent to
items.explanation: destination /ˌdes.tɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): đích đến. "Destination address" = địa chỉ đích; đối lập với "source" (nguồn).
items.explanationEn: destination /ˌdes.tɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (noun): the place something is sent to. "Destination address" is where data goes; its pair is "source".

items.question: Trong câu "Each router has a public IP address assigned by the Internet Service Provider (ISP).", từ "public" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each router has a public IP address assigned by the Internet Service Provider (ISP).", what does "public" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: public /ˈpʌb.lɪk/ (tính từ): công khai, công cộng. "Public IP address" = địa chỉ IP công khai; trái nghĩa: private.
items.explanationEn: public /ˈpʌb.lɪk/ (adjective): open and visible to everyone. "Public IP address" is visible on the Internet; opposite: private.

items.question: Trong câu "Each router has a public IP address assigned by the Internet Service Provider (ISP).", từ "assign" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each router has a public IP address assigned by the Internet Service Provider (ISP).", what does "assign" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give out for a purpose
items.explanation: assign /əˈsaɪn/ (động từ): cấp, gán. "Be assigned by" = được cấp bởi; danh từ: assignment.
items.explanationEn: assign /əˈsaɪn/ (verb): to give out for a purpose. "Be assigned by" means given out by; noun: assignment.

items.question: Trong câu "Each router has a public IP address assigned by the Internet Service Provider (ISP).", từ "provider" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each router has a public IP address assigned by the Internet Service Provider (ISP).", what does "provider" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person who supports a family
a company that supplies a service
a person who buys a service
a person who puts in money
items.explanation: provider /prəˈvaɪ.dər/ (danh từ): nhà cung cấp. "Internet Service Provider" = nhà cung cấp dịch vụ Internet; "cloud provider" = nhà cung cấp đám mây.
items.explanationEn: provider /prəˈvaɪ.dər/ (noun): a company that supplies a service. "Internet Service Provider" supplies Internet access; also "cloud provider".

items.question: Trong câu "Home routers often double as a WiFi access point.", từ "double as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Home routers often double as a WiFi access point.", what does "double as" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to also serve as something else
to stand in for an actor
items.explanation: double as /ˈdʌb.əl æz/ (cụm từ): kiêm luôn vai trò. "A doubles as B" = A kiêm luôn chức năng B: the router doubles as an access point.
items.explanationEn: double as /ˈdʌb.əl æz/ (phrase): to also serve as something else. "A doubles as B" means A also works as B: the router doubles as an access point.

items.question: Trong câu "Home routers often double as a WiFi access point.", từ "access" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Home routers often double as a WiFi access point.", what does "access" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the ability to connect and use
items.explanation: access /ˈæk.ses/ (danh từ): sự truy cập. "Access point" = điểm truy cập; "have access to" = có quyền truy cập vào.
items.explanationEn: access /ˈæk.ses/ (noun): the ability to connect and use. "Access point" is where devices join; "have access to" means being able to use.

items.question: Trong câu "It transfers data directly between two devices that need to communicate.", từ "transfer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It transfers data directly between two devices that need to communicate.", what does "transfer" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move from one place to another
to move to a new job
to send money to an account
items.explanation: transfer /trænsˈfɜːr/ (động từ): truyền, chuyển. "Transfer data/files" = truyền dữ liệu/tệp; "file transfer" = truyền tệp.
items.explanationEn: transfer /trænsˈfɜːr/ (verb): to move from one place to another. "Transfer data/files" means moving them; noun phrase: file transfer.

items.question: Trong câu "It transfers data directly between two devices that need to communicate.", từ "directly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It transfers data directly between two devices that need to communicate.", what does "directly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: directly /daɪˈrekt.li/ (trạng từ): trực tiếp. "Directly between two devices" = trực tiếp giữa hai thiết bị; trái nghĩa: indirectly.
items.explanationEn: directly /daɪˈrekt.li/ (adverb): without anything in between. "Directly between two devices" means with no middle step; opposite: indirectly.

items.question: Trong câu "It transfers data directly between two devices that need to communicate.", từ "communicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It transfers data directly between two devices that need to communicate.", what does "communicate" (verb) mean?
options: giao tiếp, trao đổi dữ liệu
items.explanation: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): giao tiếp, trao đổi dữ liệu. "Devices communicate" = các thiết bị trao đổi dữ liệu; danh từ: communication.
items.explanationEn: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to exchange information. "Devices communicate" means they exchange data; noun: communication.

items.question: Trong câu "Unlike a router: a switch works within the local network and does not connect out to the Internet.", từ "unlike" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Unlike a router: a switch works within the local network and does not connect out to the Internet.", what does "unlike" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: unlike /ʌnˈlaɪk/ (giới từ): không giống như. "Unlike X, Y ..." dùng để so sánh sự khác biệt; trái nghĩa: like, similar to.
items.explanationEn: unlike /ʌnˈlaɪk/ (preposition): different from. "Unlike X, Y ..." introduces a contrast; opposite: like, similar to.

items.question: Trong câu "Broadcasts WiFi so devices can connect wirelessly.", từ "broadcast" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Broadcasts WiFi so devices can connect wirelessly.", what does "broadcast" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to send a signal out widely
items.explanation: broadcast /ˈbrɔːd.kɑːst/ (động từ): phát (sóng) ra. "Broadcast WiFi" = phát sóng WiFi; trong mạng, "broadcast" còn là gửi gói tin tới mọi máy.
items.explanationEn: broadcast /ˈbrɔːd.kɑːst/ (verb): to send a signal out widely. "Broadcast WiFi" means sending it out; in networking it also means sending to every host.

items.question: Trong câu "Broadcasts WiFi so devices can connect wirelessly.", từ "wirelessly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Broadcasts WiFi so devices can connect wirelessly.", what does "wirelessly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: wirelessly /ˈwaɪə.ləs.li/ (trạng từ): không dây. "Connect wirelessly" = kết nối không dây; tính từ: wireless.
items.explanationEn: wirelessly /ˈwaɪə.ləs.li/ (adverb): without using cables. "Connect wirelessly" means with no cables; adjective: wireless.

items.question: Trong câu "Home routers usually have a built-in access point.", từ "built-in" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Home routers usually have a built-in access point.", what does "built-in" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: built-in /ˌbɪltˈɪn/ (tính từ): tích hợp sẵn. "A built-in access point" = điểm truy cập có sẵn; gần nghĩa: integrated.
items.explanationEn: built-in /ˌbɪltˈɪn/ (adjective): included as part of it. "A built-in access point" comes included; similar: integrated.

items.question: Trong câu "A device that converts the signal from the ISP (copper cable, fiber optic, etc.) into a digital signal the router can understand.", từ "convert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A device that converts the signal from the ISP (copper cable, fiber optic, etc.) into a digital signal the router can understand.", what does "convert" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to turn back the other way
items.explanation: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (động từ): chuyển đổi. "Convert A into B" = chuyển A thành B; danh từ: conversion, converter.
items.explanationEn: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (verb): to change into another form. "Convert A into B" changes A into B; nouns: conversion, converter.

items.question: Trong câu "A device that converts the signal from the ISP (copper cable, fiber optic, etc.) into a digital signal the router can understand.", từ "copper" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A device that converts the signal from the ISP (copper cable, fiber optic, etc.) into a digital signal the router can understand.", what does "copper" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: copper /ˈkɒp.ər/ (danh từ): đồng (kim loại). "Copper cable" = cáp đồng; thường so sánh với "fiber optic" (cáp quang).
items.explanationEn: copper /ˈkɒp.ər/ (noun): a reddish-brown metal. "Copper cable" is metal wiring, often compared with fiber optic.

items.question: Trong câu "A device that converts the signal from the ISP (copper cable, fiber optic, etc.) into a digital signal the router can understand.", từ "fiber" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A device that converts the signal from the ISP (copper cable, fiber optic, etc.) into a digital signal the router can understand.", what does "fiber" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a thin glass thread for signals
items.explanation: fiber /ˈfaɪ.bər/ (danh từ): sợi (quang). "Fiber optic" = cáp quang; Anh-Anh viết "fibre"; "fiber" trong thực phẩm là chất xơ.
items.explanationEn: fiber /ˈfaɪ.bər/ (noun): a thin glass thread for signals. "Fiber optic" cable carries light; British spelling is "fibre"; in food, fiber is plant matter.

items.question: Trong câu "A device that converts the signal from the ISP (copper cable, fiber optic, etc.) into a digital signal the router can understand.", từ "digital" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A device that converts the signal from the ISP (copper cable, fiber optic, etc.) into a digital signal the router can understand.", what does "digital" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: digital /ˈdɪdʒ.ɪ.təl/ (tính từ): kỹ thuật số. "Digital signal" = tín hiệu số; đối lập với "analog signal" (tín hiệu tương tự).
items.explanationEn: digital /ˈdɪdʒ.ɪ.təl/ (adjective): using data as 0s and 1s. "Digital signal" uses discrete values; its opposite is "analog signal".

items.question: Trong câu "Data transmitted over a network is broken into small packets.", từ "transmit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data transmitted over a network is broken into small packets.", what does "transmit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: transmit /trænzˈmɪt/ (động từ): truyền (tải). "Data transmitted over a network" = dữ liệu được truyền qua mạng; danh từ: transmission.
items.explanationEn: transmit /trænzˈmɪt/ (verb): to send over a network. "Data transmitted over a network" is sent across it; noun: transmission.

items.question: Trong câu "Data transmitted over a network is broken into small packets.", từ "break into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data transmitted over a network is broken into small packets.", what does "break into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: break into /breɪk ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): chia nhỏ thành. "Be broken into packets" = bị chia thành các gói; "break into a house" lại là đột nhập.
items.explanationEn: break into /breɪk ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to split into parts. "Be broken into packets" means split up; "break into a house" means to enter by force.

items.question: Trong câu "Each packet contains:", từ "contain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each packet contains:", what does "contain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (động từ): chứa, bao gồm. "Each packet contains ..." = mỗi gói chứa ...; danh từ: container.
items.explanationEn: contain /kənˈteɪn/ (verb): to have inside. "Each packet contains ..." lists what is inside; noun: container.

items.question: Trong câu "Packets travel through many different routers before reaching their destination, and are then reassembled in order.", từ "travel" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Packets travel through many different routers before reaching their destination, and are then reassembled in order.", what does "travel" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to go on a holiday trip
to move from place to place
items.explanation: travel /ˈtræv.əl/ (động từ): di chuyển, đi qua. "Packets travel through routers" = gói tin đi qua các router; không chỉ dùng cho người đi du lịch.
items.explanationEn: travel /ˈtræv.əl/ (verb): to move from place to place. "Packets travel through routers" means moving across them, not only people on trips.

items.question: Trong câu "Packets travel through many different routers before reaching their destination, and are then reassembled in order.", từ "reach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Packets travel through many different routers before reaching their destination, and are then reassembled in order.", what does "reach" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reach /riːtʃ/ (động từ): đến, tới. "Reach the destination" = đến đích (không dùng "reach to"); danh từ: reach (tầm với).
items.explanationEn: reach /riːtʃ/ (verb): to arrive at. "Reach the destination" means arrive there (no "to"); noun: reach.

items.question: Trong câu "Packets travel through many different routers before reaching their destination, and are then reassembled in order.", từ "reassemble" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Packets travel through many different routers before reaching their destination, and are then reassembled in order.", what does "reassemble" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to gather as a group again
to put in a new order
items.explanation: reassemble /ˌriː.əˈsem.bəl/ (động từ): ghép lại. "Be reassembled in order" = được ghép lại theo thứ tự; tiền tố re- = lại, assemble = lắp ráp.
items.explanationEn: reassemble /ˌriː.əˈsem.bəl/ (verb): to put parts back together. "Be reassembled in order" means put back together; re- means again, assemble means put together.

items.question: Trong câu "Packets travel through many different routers before reaching their destination, and are then reassembled in order.", từ "in order" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Packets travel through many different routers before reaching their destination, and are then reassembled in order.", what does "in order" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in order /ɪn ˈɔː.dər/ (cụm từ): theo đúng thứ tự. "In order" = theo thứ tự; khác với "in order to" (để mà).
items.explanationEn: in order /ɪn ˈɔː.dər/ (phrase): in the correct sequence. "In order" means in sequence; don't confuse with "in order to" (so that).

items.question: Trong câu "Bandwidth: the maximum amount of data that can be transmitted in 1 second.", từ "maximum" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bandwidth: the maximum amount of data that can be transmitted in 1 second.", what does "maximum" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: maximum /ˈmæk.sɪ.məm/ (tính từ): tối đa. "The maximum amount" = lượng tối đa; viết tắt "max"; trái nghĩa: minimum.
items.explanationEn: maximum /ˈmæk.sɪ.məm/ (adjective): the largest possible. "The maximum amount" is the most allowed; short form "max"; opposite: minimum.

items.question: Trong câu "Bandwidth: the maximum amount of data that can be transmitted in 1 second.", từ "amount" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bandwidth: the maximum amount of data that can be transmitted in 1 second.", what does "amount" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: amount /əˈmaʊnt/ (danh từ): lượng. "Amount of data" (danh từ không đếm được) = lượng dữ liệu; dùng "number of" cho danh từ đếm được.
items.explanationEn: amount /əˈmaʊnt/ (noun): a quantity of something. Use "amount of" with uncountable nouns (data) and "number of" with countable ones.

items.question: Trong câu "100 Mbps = 100 million bits/second ≈ 12.5 MB/s of actual download speed.", từ "actual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "100 Mbps = 100 million bits/second ≈ 12.5 MB/s of actual download speed.", what does "actual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: actual /ˈæk.tʃu.əl/ (tính từ): thực tế. "Actual download speed" = tốc độ tải thực tế; lưu ý "actual" không có nghĩa "hiện tại" (current).
items.explanationEn: actual /ˈæk.tʃu.əl/ (adjective): real, as it really is. "Actual download speed" is the real speed; note "actual" does not mean "current".

items.question: Trong câu "Latency/Ping: the time it takes for a packet to travel from A to B and back.", từ "latency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Latency/Ping: the time it takes for a packet to travel from A to B and back.", what does "latency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: latency /ˈleɪ.tən.si/ (danh từ): độ trễ. "Low latency" = độ trễ thấp (tốt); "high latency" = trễ cao.
items.explanationEn: latency /ˈleɪ.tən.si/ (noun): the delay before data arrives. "Low latency" is good; "high latency" means long delays.

items.question: Trong câu "Latency/Ping: the time it takes for a packet to travel from A to B and back.", từ "it takes" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Latency/Ping: the time it takes for a packet to travel from A to B and back.", what does "it takes" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: it takes /ɪt ˈteɪks/ (cụm từ): mất (bao nhiêu thời gian). Cấu trúc "it takes (time) for X to do Y" = X mất (thời gian) để làm Y.
items.explanationEn: it takes /ɪt ˈteɪks/ (phrase): needs a certain time. Pattern: "it takes (time) for X to do Y" gives the time needed.

items.question: Trong câu "Low ping = a fast-responding network.", từ "respond" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Low ping = a fast-responding network.", what does "respond" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: respond /rɪˈspɒnd/ (động từ): phản hồi. "A fast-responding network" = mạng phản hồi nhanh; danh từ: response.
items.explanationEn: respond /rɪˈspɒnd/ (verb): to reply or react. "A fast-responding network" replies quickly; noun: response.

items.question: Trong câu "High bandwidth does not mean low ping.", từ "bandwidth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "High bandwidth does not mean low ping.", what does "bandwidth" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the maximum data rate of a link
items.explanation: bandwidth /ˈbænd.wɪdθ/ (danh từ): băng thông. "High bandwidth" = băng thông lớn; nghĩa bóng trong công sở: "I don't have the bandwidth" = tôi không còn sức/thời gian.
items.explanationEn: bandwidth /ˈbænd.wɪdθ/ (noun): the maximum data rate of a link. "High bandwidth" means a big data rate; at work, "I don't have the bandwidth" means no spare capacity.

items.question: Trong câu "A satellite link can have high bandwidth but very high ping (>500ms).", từ "satellite" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A satellite link can have high bandwidth but very high ping (>500ms).", what does "satellite" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: satellite /ˈsæt.əl.aɪt/ (danh từ): vệ tinh. "Satellite link/internet" = đường truyền/Internet vệ tinh; độ trễ cao vì tín hiệu đi rất xa.
items.explanationEn: satellite /ˈsæt.əl.aɪt/ (noun): a device orbiting the Earth. "Satellite link/internet" has high latency because signals travel very far.

items.question: Trong câu "A satellite link can have high bandwidth but very high ping (>500ms).", từ "link" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A satellite link can have high bandwidth but very high ping (>500ms).", what does "link" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: link /lɪŋk/ (danh từ): đường truyền, kết nối. "A satellite link" = đường truyền vệ tinh; "link" còn là đường dẫn web hoặc mắt xích.
items.explanationEn: link /lɪŋk/ (noun): a connection carrying data. "A satellite link" is a data connection; "link" can also be a web link or a chain ring.

items.question: Trong câu "Every device in a network has an IP address (Internet Protocol address) for identification.", từ "device" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every device in a network has an IP address (Internet Protocol address) for identification.", what does "device" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a machine built for a purpose
items.explanation: device /dɪˈvaɪs/ (danh từ): thiết bị. "Every device in a network" = mọi thiết bị trong mạng; số nhiều: devices.
items.explanationEn: device /dɪˈvaɪs/ (noun): a machine built for a purpose. "Every device in a network" means each machine on it; plural: devices.

items.question: Trong câu "Every device in a network has an IP address (Internet Protocol address) for identification.", từ "address" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every device in a network has an IP address (Internet Protocol address) for identification.", what does "address" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a unique label to find something
items.explanation: address /əˈdres/ (danh từ): địa chỉ. "IP address" = địa chỉ IP; động từ "address a problem" = giải quyết vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: address /əˈdres/ (noun): a unique label to find something. "IP address" locates a device; the verb "address a problem" means to deal with it.

items.question: Trong câu "Every device in a network has an IP address (Internet Protocol address) for identification.", từ "protocol" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every device in a network has an IP address (Internet Protocol address) for identification.", what does "protocol" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a set of rules for communication
a written record of a meeting
items.explanation: protocol /ˈprəʊ.tə.kɒl/ (danh từ): giao thức. "Internet Protocol" = giao thức Internet; "protocol" trong ngoại giao là nghi thức.
items.explanationEn: protocol /ˈprəʊ.tə.kɒl/ (noun): a set of rules for communication. "Internet Protocol" is a set of rules for data; in diplomacy "protocol" means formal etiquette.

items.question: Trong câu "Every device in a network has an IP address (Internet Protocol address) for identification.", từ "identification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every device in a network has an IP address (Internet Protocol address) for identification.", what does "identification" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: recognising who or what it is
items.explanation: identification /aɪˌden.tɪ.fɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự nhận dạng. "For identification" = để nhận dạng; động từ: identify; viết tắt ID.
items.explanationEn: identification /aɪˌden.tɪ.fɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): recognising who or what it is. "For identification" means to tell things apart; verb: identify; short form: ID.

items.question: Trong câu "When you visit google.com, the packet travels from your private IP → router → public IP → the Internet → Google.", từ "visit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you visit google.com, the packet travels from your private IP → router → public IP → the Internet → Google.", what does "visit" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to go and see a person
items.explanation: visit /ˈvɪz.ɪt/ (động từ): truy cập (trang web). "Visit a website" = truy cập trang web; danh từ: visitor (khách truy cập).
items.explanationEn: visit /ˈvɪz.ɪt/ (verb): to go to a website. "Visit a website" means opening it; noun: visitor.

items.question: Trong câu "When you visit google.com, the packet travels from your private IP → router → public IP → the Internet → Google.", từ "private" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you visit google.com, the packet travels from your private IP → router → public IP → the Internet → Google.", what does "private" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: private /ˈpraɪ.vət/ (tính từ): riêng, nội bộ. "Private IP" = IP riêng dùng trong LAN; trái nghĩa: public.
items.explanationEn: private /ˈpraɪ.vət/ (adjective): used only inside one network. "Private IP" is only used inside a LAN; opposite: public.

items.question: Trong câu "When you visit google.com, the packet travels from your private IP → router → public IP → the Internet → Google.", từ "packet" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you visit google.com, the packet travels from your private IP → router → public IP → the Internet → Google.", what does "packet" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a small paper box of goods
a small unit of network data
items.explanation: packet /ˈpæk.ɪt/ (danh từ): gói tin. "The packet travels" = gói tin di chuyển; ngoài IT, "a packet of biscuits" = một gói bánh.
items.explanationEn: packet /ˈpæk.ɪt/ (noun): a small unit of network data. "The packet travels" means network data moves; outside IT, "a packet of biscuits" is a pack.

items.question: Trong câu "Every device in a network has an IP address (Internet Protocol address) for identification.", từ "network" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every device in a network has an IP address (Internet Protocol address) for identification.", what does "network" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: network /ˈnet.wɜːk/ (danh từ): mạng (máy tính). "A device in a network" = thiết bị trong mạng; động từ "network" = xây dựng quan hệ.
items.explanationEn: network /ˈnet.wɜːk/ (noun): connected computers sharing data. "A device in a network" is on connected computers; the verb "network" means to build contacts.

items.question: Trong câu "WAN/Internet: a global network.", từ "global" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "WAN/Internet: a global network.", what does "global" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: global /ˈɡləʊ.bəl/ (tính từ): toàn cầu. "A global network" = mạng toàn cầu; "global variable" trong lập trình = biến toàn cục.
items.explanationEn: global /ˈɡləʊ.bəl/ (adjective): covering the whole world. "A global network" spans the world; in code, a "global variable" is usable everywhere.

items.question: Trong câu "Packet: the unit of data transmitted over a network.", từ "unit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Packet: the unit of data transmitted over a network.", what does "unit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: unit /ˈjuː.nɪt/ (danh từ): đơn vị. "The unit of data" = đơn vị dữ liệu; "unit test" = kiểm thử đơn vị.
items.explanationEn: unit /ˈjuː.nɪt/ (noun): a single standard piece. "The unit of data" is one standard piece; "unit test" tests one small part.

items.question: Trong câu "Bandwidth: the maximum speed, measured in Mbps/Gbps.", từ "measure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bandwidth: the maximum speed, measured in Mbps/Gbps.", what does "measure" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to find the size or amount
items.explanation: measure /ˈmeʒ.ər/ (động từ): đo (lường). "Measured in Mbps" = được đo bằng Mbps; danh từ: measurement.
items.explanationEn: measure /ˈmeʒ.ər/ (verb): to find the size or amount. "Measured in Mbps" gives the unit; noun: measurement.

items.question: Trong câu "Router: connects a LAN to the Internet.", từ "connect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Router: connects a LAN to the Internet.", what does "connect" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to get on well with someone
items.explanation: connect /kəˈnekt/ (động từ): kết nối. "Connect A to B" = nối A với B; danh từ: connection.
items.explanationEn: connect /kəˈnekt/ (verb): to join things together. "Connect A to B" joins them; noun: connection.
